findings.reason: the predicate is a single correct literal and each site names a different node alias, so a helper buys little; the finding is advisory, not load-bearing, and the plan's per-site comment ("diagnostic/physics_domain stay as post-filters") already documents the intent.
findings.text: the plan renders the facility pre-filter predicate literally at each call site instead of through the schema owner that already declares which embedding slots carry `facility_id`; §16 and §18 between them write the same predicate at eight sites where a small `facility_prefilter(alias)` helper on the vector-search/schema owner would hold one string

duplicate_owner-1.reason: the predicate is one correct literal with a different node alias at each site, rendered through the single prefilter_clauses path of build_vector_search; a helper would hold one string and buy little, as the review itself notes

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is introduced; §16/§18 add a `prefilter_clauses` argument to the one deep search-block builder already used by every vector search, and §17 adds one fragment helper to the existing label-parameterised embed worker, so behaviour stays behind interfaces no larger than what they hide.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the facility pre-filter predicate `<alias>.facility_id = $facility` is hand-written at every vector-search call site (imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:486, imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:134,282,466) and §18 adds two more (imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/wiki.py:312, imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:3563), while the schema already owns which slots carry the property via `GraphSchema.vector_index_filters` (imas_codex/graph/schema.py:274); no owner renders the predicate from that annotation.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0. Each implementable section accounts for its surface in its own text: §16, §17 and §18 each carry an explicit "Interface budget: nothing added" and name what they retire (the facility post-filter, the manual-clear docstring instruction, the two post-filter predicates respectively), §9 adds no CLI option (it changes an internal signature and counts probe calls), and §14 adds no option (it reuses `discover paths --root`).
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — every implementable section names the existing owner it extends and the code confirms it: §9 rewrites the three hand-written DataAccess MERGEs into the existing `persist_data_access` (imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:2385), §16/§18 reuse `build_vector_search` and the `GraphSchema.vector_index_filters` annotation (imas_codex/graph/schema.py:274, imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py:17), §17 extends the existing `embed_worker` fragment pattern (`_SCORE_JOINS`, embed_worker.py:64) and `reset_to`, and §14 uses the existing `discover paths --root` seeding filter (imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:20, `seed_facility_roots`). No proposed section rebuilds machinery that already exists.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the two extractions the plan performs (§9's `persist_data_access`, §17's predicate fragment) each replace duplicated inline statements with a single owner and state that rationale; neither is a new layer over machinery it could have extended.
